01 // ARCHITECTURAL INTENT

THE HIGH-VELOCITY GAME COMPANION BUILT ON RUST.

Traditional gaming utilities are bloated web wrappers consuming hundreds of megabytes of background memory. Micah 0xC changes the formula: an ultra-compact Tauri 2 native shell engineered to run silent, consume less than 45MB of RAM, and fuse game discovery with deep Steam automation.

01 // LOCAL FIRST

Zero Cloud Telemetry

All configuration, game libraries, and Lua manifests reside locally in your machine's app data directory. No tracking, no mandatory cloud accounts.

02 // TAURI 2 + RUST

Native OS Direct Calls

Powered by Rust commands using direct Windows API hooks, targeted TOML mutation, and hyper-fast async reqwest networking.

03 // NON-DESTRUCTIVE

Surgical TOML Edits

Modifications to Steam configuration files preserve all existing user preferences, comments, and structure without file truncation.

02 // CORE CAPABILITIES

ENGINEERED FOR CONTROL, PRECISION AND SPEED.

Six foundational subsystems purpose-built to eliminate friction across your game library.

Download manifests from GitHub Manifest Hub with one click. Automatically saves into lua_scripts as <AppID>_<Game>.lua, bridges directly into Steam config, and performs a surgical TOML edit so changes apply instantly without restarting Steam.

ARCHITECTURE HIGHLIGHT // NON-DESTRUCTIVE CONFIG SURGICAL TOML MUTATION

Instead of serializing and rewriting the entire micah_mode.toml document—which would wipe out user comments and custom sections—Micah 0xC executes targeted string splicing directly against the AST. Your custom parameters remain untouched.

05 // TELEMETRY HUD

HARDWARE INTERROGATION WITHOUT MEMORY OVERHEAD.

The embedded System Info Card provides instantaneous awareness of hardware utilization. Built with Tauri 2 in Rust, the app maintains an ultralow footprint so your GPU and CPU cycles belong to your games.

MONITOR 01 CPU SCHEDULER
LOCAL WMI INTERROGATION

Enumerates processor topology, thread allocation, and base frequency via native Windows APIs without background polling spikes.

MONITOR 02 RAM CONSUMPTION
< 45 MB RESIDENT RAM

Tauri 2 replaces bloated Electron Chromium runtimes with the lightweight OS native WebView2 control, cutting idle memory by up to 85%.

MONITOR 03 GPU ADAPTER ENUM
DIRECT HARDWARE ID

Identifies discrete and integrated graphics adapters to ensure your active graphics pipeline matches game minimum requirements.

MONITOR 04 OS KERNEL & TOAST
PORTAL STACKING CONTEXT

System toast notifications render via top-level portals into the document body, guaranteeing zero occlusion by modals or overlays.

manager.rs // auto_save_and_import_lua RUST TAURI 2 
// Fetch Lua from Manifest Hub (branch ref=<appid>) and link to Steam config
pub async fn auto_save_and_import_lua(app_id: &str, game_name: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
    let target_file = format!("{}_{}.lua", app_id, sanitize_filename(game_name));
    let dest_path = steam_lua_dir.join(format!("{}.lua", app_id));
    
    // Register into micah_mode.toml [lua] paths via surgical string splice
    register_lua_path_surgical(&dest_path)?;
    // DLL file watcher hot-reloads instantly — NO STEAM RESTART REQUIRED
    Ok(())
}
